analysis_summary: The document 'new-fundamental-truths.md' has both content gaps vs ADR-034 and structural/style issues. The most critical issue is workspace-centric terminology ('IDE mode', 'Notes mode', 'ide-related-plugins') which conflicts with ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001's Platform-First approach. The document also lacks route structure definitions, plugin interface specifications, and current phase status. Accuracy-wise: GPT-5.2 EXISTS (released Dec 11, 2025) and Claude 4.5 EXISTS (Sonnet Sep 2025, Opus Nov 2025) - contrary to a previous incorrect analysis. Structural issues include informal language, inconsistent heading hierarchy, missing frontmatter, and broken references.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034 defines only 2 routes: /hub and /$projectId. The document mentions /setting for BYOK Vault but omits the overall route architecture.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add explicit route structure section: /hub (project management), /$projectId (unified project view). Deprecate /setting, /ide/$projectId, /notes/$projectId, /knowledge/$projectId, /study/$projectId.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 eliminates 'IDE mode' vs 'Notes mode' in favor of platform-determined plugins. The document uses workspace-centric terminology throughout.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Replace workspace-centric references with platform-first approach. Add getDefaultPlugins() and getDefaultLayoutMode() definitions from the amendment.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034 defines a complete FeaturePlugin interface with id, name, icon, component, requiresFSA, requiresProject, minWidth, maxInstances. The document lacks this technical definition.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add the FeaturePlugin interface definition to provide architects with the contract for plugin development.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 defines platform-specific defaults: Desktop+FSA = ['filetree', 'monaco', 'chat']; Desktop+IndexedDB = ['filetree', 'notes', 'chat']; Tablet = ['filetree', 'notes', 'chat']; Mobile = ['notes']. The document mentions 'up-to-5 plugins' without platform-aware logic.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add platform-aware default plugin section with the getDefaultPlugins() function and mapping table.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034 defines 4 layout modes: 1-column, 2-column, 3-column, 2+1 (main + sidebar). The document mentions 'progressive disclosure patterns' but omits concrete layout specs.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add layout mode definitions and getDefaultLayoutMode() function showing how platform determines default layout.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034 has EPIC-ARCH-01, EPIC-ARCH-02 (COMPLETE), EPIC-ARCH-03 (IN PROGRESS), EPIC-ARCH-04 (PENDING). The document reflects pre-ADR-034 thinking.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add current implementation phase status so architects know what's done vs. pending.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 provides detailed migration steps. The document has no migration guidance.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add migration section with files to modify, verification commands, and rollback strategy.

gaps_identified.description: ADR-034 defines FeaturePlugin interface but document doesn't reference or elaborate on required API contracts.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add FeaturePlugin interface code block and explain each property's purpose.

gaps_identified.description: DexieDB quota handling, FSA permission failures, offline-first fallbacks are mentioned as concerns but not addressed.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add error handling section with patterns for each failure scenario.

gaps_identified.description: Lines mention agent permissions but no concrete permission schema is provided.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add permission matrix: Read/Write/Execute per tool type, per platform.

gaps_identified.description: Document mentions RAG features but provides no implementation approach for local RAG vectors.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add RAG strategy: chunking approach, embedding model, storage location in Dexie.

gaps_identified.description: Mentions 'portrait phone screen' but no concrete responsive layout patterns for plugins on small screens.
gaps_identified.recommendation: Add mobile UX section: 1-column layout, tabbed button pattern for always-loaded plugins.

conflicts_with_adr034.document_says: ide-related-plugins are not loaded for Non-pc-entries, notion-like-note and knowledge-synthesis, RAG features for other features
conflicts_with_adr034.adr034_says: Platform determines available plugins, not user-selected workspace mode. Desktop with FSA shows Monaco, Desktop with IndexedDB shows Notes, Mobile shows Notes only.
conflicts_with_adr034.resolution: Replace all workspace-centric language with platform-first approach.

conflicts_with_adr034.document_says: BYOK Vault is originally routed at /setting
conflicts_with_adr034.adr034_says: Only 2 routes exist: /hub and /$projectId. All other routes redirect to /$projectId.
conflicts_with_adr034.resolution: Move BYOK Vault configuration into project context or hub sidebar. Deprecate /setting route.

conflicts_with_adr034.document_says: Up-to-5 plugins in desktops including 2 always-loaded ones, with 3 multiplication variants in total number of plugins
conflicts_with_adr034.adr034_says: Platform-aware defaults: Desktop+FSA gets 3 plugins (filetree, monaco, chat), other platforms get 2-3 plugins. No 'IDE mode' or 'Notes mode' presets.
conflicts_with_adr034.resolution: Replace plugin count discussion with platform-aware default plugin table.

conflicts_with_adr034.document_says: References /ide/$projectId and /notes/$projectId as active routes throughout
conflicts_with_adr034.adr034_says: These routes are deprecated and should redirect to /$projectId without layout params. No more ?layout=ide or ?layout=notes query params.
conflicts_with_adr034.resolution: Update all route references to use /$projectId. Deprecation messages should be added to old routes.

accuracy_issues.issue: GPT-5.2 and Claude 4.5 existence (CORRECTION from previous analysis)
accuracy_issues.current_claim: OpenAI GPT 5.2 variants, Claude 4.5 for Sonnet, Opus and Haiku variants
accuracy_issues.verified_fact: GPT-5.2 released December 11, 2025 (source: openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-2/). Claude Sonnet 4.5 released September 30, 2025. Claude Opus 4.5 released November 24, 2025 (source: anthropic.com/claude/sonnet, anthropic.com/claude/opus). Claude Haiku 4.5 UNVERIFIED - no official source found.
accuracy_issues.correction: GPT-5.2 claim is CORRECT. Claude Haiku 4.5 needs verification - change to 'Claude 4.5 for Sonnet and Opus (Haiku 4.5 unconfirmed)'.

accuracy_issues.current_claim: Use TanStack AI SDK & TanStack Start for BYOK Vault
accuracy_issues.verified_fact: AGENTS.md lists 'Google Gemini (via @tanstack/ai-gemini)'. TanStack AI SDK is correct for AI provider abstraction. TanStack Start is the full-stack framework.
accuracy_issues.correction: Clarify: Use @tanstack/ai-gemini for Gemini provider, @tanstack/ai for general AI SDK patterns. TanStack Start is the application framework.

accuracy_issues.current_claim: Clearly define and connect Zustand (client state) and Dexie (persisted data) usage
accuracy_issues.verified_fact: ADR-033 already defines StorageGateway, PlatformContract interfaces. The boundaries are documented but document doesn't reference them.
accuracy_issues.correction: Add reference to ADR-033 StorageGateway interface and PlatformContract. Don't redefine what's already in ADR-033.

'THE TWO-ALWAYS-LOADED-PLUGINS', 'pretty much', 'these are just a few as I thought of', 'this is not enough', ' ultrathink for this matter'
No title metadata, author, version, status, or date - violates BMAD artifact standards
Lines 22, 29, 40 use 'and so many more', 'etc.', 'and so on' - vague requirements
163-line document with no TOC, making it hard to navigate
Informal bullet points alongside markdown code blocks, inconsistent with technical documentation standards

causality_chain.description: Document concepts have causal relationships that should be explicitly mapped for architects.

Monaco/Terminal only on Desktop+FSA; Notes available on all platforms; Mobile limited to 1-column layout
No more /ide/$projectId or /notes/$projectId routes; single /$projectId with platform-filtered plugins
All LLM calls must use TanStack AI SDK, not direct provider packages; keys passed reactively to agents

chains.effect: Thread management tied to project ID
chains.implication: Context window limits (150k tokens), auto-thread creation on 90% threshold, RAG context per project

chains.effect: Project management and Chat cascade must load on all platforms
chains.implication: These plugins require no FSA; other plugins (Monaco, Terminal) have requiresFSA flag = true

priority_improvements.area: Replace workspace-centric terminology with Platform-First approach
priority_improvements.rationale: Fundamental contradiction that will cause architects to implement the wrong architecture. ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 explicitly eliminates 'IDE mode' vs 'Notes mode'. Must be updated before document can serve as source of truth.
Architects need concrete rules for which plugins load on which platforms. ADR-034-AMENDMENT-001 provides specific mappings that are missing from the document.
Document mentions /setting but ADR-034 defines only /hub and /$projectId. Must be resolved for consistent navigation.

priority_improvements.area: Fix Claude Haiku 4.5 accuracy issue and correct previous analysis error on GPT-5.2
priority_improvements.rationale: GPT-5.2 EXISTS (released Dec 11, 2025). Claude 4.5 EXISTS for Sonnet and Opus. Previous analysis incorrectly claimed these don't exist.

priority_improvements.area: Add Phase Status and Migration Guidance
priority_improvements.rationale: Architects need to know what's already done (EPIC-ARCH-01, EPIC-ARCH-02 COMPLETE) vs. pending. This prevents redundant work.
Line 26 references a file that doesn't exist. Either create it or remove the reference.

priority_improvements.area: Add frontmatter and fix heading hierarchy
priority_improvements.rationale: Missing frontmatter violates BMAD standards. Inconsistent heading hierarchy makes document hard to navigate.

summary.recommendation: Document needs substantial revision before it can serve as a valid reference. Priority actions: 1) Replace workspace-centric terminology with Platform-First approach, 2) Add route structure definition, 3) Add Platform-Aware Default Plugin specifications, 4) Fix broken reference to fundamental-truth-check-list.md, 5) Add frontmatter, 6) Correct Claude Haiku 4.5 (GPT-5.2 is correct), 7) Add phase status tracking.
